KPEX 2026 is Just Around the Corner!

Final Call for Exhibitors — Pre-Register to Visit Now!

 

KPEX 2026, Korea’s leading exhibition for policing, security, and public safety, is coming this October.

 

With leading companies, police agencies, public institutions, international police delegations, and global buyers coming together in one place, KPEX 2026 offers a unique platform to showcase your latest technologies and create new business opportunities.

 

Booth availability is becoming limited. Secure your booth now and be part of KPEX 2026!

📆 Date: October 21 (Wed) – 24 (Sat), 2026 (4 days)

🚩 Venue: Songdo ConvensiA, Incheon, Korea

✅ Host: Korean National Police Agency, Incheon Metropolitan City

✅ Organizer: Incheon Tourism Organization, MESSE ESANG Co., Ltd.

✅ Sponsor: Ministry of the Interior and Safety, Ministry of Science and ICT, Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources, Ministry of Intellectual Property, Korea Coast Guard, National Fire Agency, Public Procurement Service, Korea Invention Promotion Association, Korea Information Security Industry Association, Korean Association of Crime Scene Investigator, Korea CPTED Association, KOHSIA, Korea Physical AI Association, City Regeneration and Safety Association, AI·Safety Robot (Googi) Innovation Research Center

📰 Media Partners: SECURITY MIDDLE EAST, FIRE MIDDLE EAST, SECURITY & FIRE AFRICA, ASMAG.COM

💫 Exhibit Categories:

[Police] Mobility & Robotics, Police Equipment & Counter-terrorism, Crime Investigation & Forensic Equipment, Traffic & Transportation systems, Training & Support Solutions

[Security] Cybersecurity & Threat Response, Video Surveillance, Access Control, Public Safety & Integrated Control

📞 Contact: KPEX Secretariat +82-2-6121-6356 / kpex@esgroup.net

■ KPEX 2025 Highlights
Exhibition Categories
■ Korea Police Expo
■ Korea Security Expo
Physical AI & Robotics Pavilion

The Physical AI & Robotics Pavilion is a special pavilion showcasing next-generation policing and public safety solutions that combine AI and robotics technologies.

 

From Physical AI technologies that perceive, understand, and act within real-world environments to highly practical robotics solutions for patrol, surveillance, search, and disaster response, visitors can explore a wide range of technologies and products shaping the future of the policing and public safety industry — all in one place.
[Featured Exhibits]

• AI Patrol & Field Response Robots

• Autonomous Security Drones

• Robot Control & Operation Platforms

• Wearable & Field Support Robotics
Information Security Pavilion

The Information Security Pavilion is a special pavilion showcasing solutions in data privacy, data security, document security, and digital crime response.

 

From technologies that prevent data breaches and protect sensitive information to advanced solutions addressing intelligent digital crimes such as voice phishing, deepfakes, phishing, and smishing, visitors can explore a wide range of technologies supporting secure information management for both public institutions and enterprises—all in one place.
[Featured Solutions]

• Personal Data Protection & Data Security
• Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
• Digital Crime Response
• Security Consulting & Managed Services
Type of Booth
[Raw Space] USD 3,000

• Space Only (Required at least 2 booths)
  • Exhibitors should install own booth on the provided space by themselves (Exhibitors need to pay for booth manufacturing and installation)
  • Exhibitors are allowed to install booth after submitting and getting approval from service bureau for the design drawing.
[Shell-Scheme Booth] USD 3,400

• Walls, Signboard, Carpets, Electricity (1kw)
  • 1 Outlet (220v, 2 Sockets)
  • 3 Lights (Per Booth)
  • An info desk and 1 set of chairs per company
[Premium Booth] Price varies by type

• There are premium booths (Standardized high-end booths) at reasonable prices in addition to basic booths for cost reduction and effective marketing of participants.
  • The corresponding amount is for the booth construction cost (Total Cost = Raw Space Cost (space only) + Premium Booth Construction cost)
Benefits of Pre-Registration

3 Benefits of KPEX 2026 Pre-Registration!

Entrance fee is free if you complete the pre-registration!

BENEFIT 01. Free Admission

Only those who participated in the Pre-Registration can enter our exhibition for free.

BENEFIT 02. Fast Entry

Simply scan the barcode on your visitor pass for quick and easy entry.
